title: His mother’s prostrate body the fiery Columbanus in holy zeal bestrode
html_source:
St Columbanus ignored his prone mother’s pleas not to enter monastic life.

Stephen stuck to his beliefs as May Dedalus lay dead. Her love couldn’t bend his reason. He had no problem abandoning authority minutes earlier when deflecting attention from Armstrong’s stupid reponse but abandoning antireligion is going too far for Stephen.
